description: This file defines interfaces and classes for selecting and managing download mirrors, including logic for ordering, error handling, and retry strategies within a download system.

classes.name: MirrorChooser
classes.description: Interface for choosing and requesting mirrors for downloads.

classes.name: MirrorChooserImpl
classes.description: Abstract class implementing common mirror request logic, including error handling and mirror selection.

classes.name: MirrorChooserRandom
classes.description: Implementation of MirrorChooser that orders mirrors randomly.

classes.name: MirrorChooserWithParameters
classes.description: Implementation of MirrorChooser that orders mirrors based on error counts and geographic location, with retry logic.

methods.name: orderMirrors
methods.description: Abstract method to order mirrors based on specific strategy.

methods.name: mirrorRequest
methods.description: Performs a request on the best mirror, trying alternatives on failure.

methods.name: executeRequest
methods.description: Executes the provided request on a given mirror and URL.

methods.name: handleException
methods.description: Handles exceptions during mirror requests, with logging and error propagation.

methods.name: sortMirrorsByLocation
methods.description: Sorts mirrors prioritizing foreign or domestic based on preferences.
